description: Parallel code collaboration with dependency boundaries and merge pressure.

agents.task: Read collector/src/causal_trace/correlator.rs and collector/src/causal_trace/types.rs, then write a new file collector/src/causal_trace/pipeline_design.md that documents the current causal trace pipeline architecture, including: 1) data flow from BPF events to causal links, 2) key types and their relationships, 3) identified improvement areas. Use actual code references. The file should be written to disk.

Read bpf/process_new.bpf.c and collector/src/framework/runners/process.rs, then write a file docs/ebpf-enrichment-audit.md documenting: 1) current BPF event fields and their usage, 2) missing fields that would improve attribution, 3) proposed kernel-side enrichment strategy with code references.

Read frontend/src/components/dashboard/ and collector/src/server/web.rs, then write a file docs/frontend-data-contract.md specifying: 1) current frontend-backend data contracts, 2) required fields for linked timeline+process navigation, 3) SSE event schema extensions needed.

Read collector/tests/causal_trace_integration.rs and collector/src/causal_trace/correlator.rs, then write a file docs/concurrent-test-plan.md defining: 1) current test coverage gaps, 2) new test cases for concurrent agent edits, 3) ordering guarantee test strategy with code examples.
